title: Getting things done
focus: 应对, 解决, 安排, 协调, 推迟, 取消, 优先, 进展, 落实, 确认, 提醒, 调整, 来不及, 拖延, 搞定, 赶工, 督促, 分配, 对接, 落后
body:
# Getting things done

These are the words for running tasks, at work or at home: who does what, when it's due, whether it's on track. Most of them show up in every work chat and meeting, and many have a near-twin you need to keep apart. (处理, 负责, 效率 and 截止日期 are in the work lesson.)

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 应对 | yìngduì | to respond to / cope with (a situation, a challenge) |
| 解决 | jiějué | to solve / resolve (a problem, for good) |
| 安排 | ānpái | to arrange / schedule (time, people, plans) |
| 协调 | xiétiáo | to coordinate (between people or departments) |
| 推迟 | tuīchí | to postpone / push back (to a later time) |
| 取消 | qǔxiāo | to cancel |
| 优先 | yōuxiān | to give priority to / do first |
| 拖后腿 | tuō hòutuǐ | to hold others back / be a drag on the team |
| 进展 | jìnzhǎn | progress / developments (on a matter) |
| 落实 | luòshí | to carry out / make sure it actually happens (a plan, a policy) |
| 确认 | quèrèn | to confirm |
| 提醒 | tíxǐng | to remind (someone) |
| 计划 | jìhuà | plan (formal, detailed) |
| 期限 | qīxiàn | time limit / deadline (formal) |
| 步骤 | bùzhòu | step (in a process) |
| 检查 | jiǎnchá | to check / inspect (for mistakes or problems) |
| 调整 | tiáozhěng | to adjust |
| 来不及 | láibují | to not have enough time (to make it) |
| 拖延 | tuōyán | to procrastinate / drag things out |
| 搞定 | gǎodìng | to get it done / sort it out (colloquial) |
| 赶工 | gǎngōng | to rush to finish (work against a deadline) |
| 督促 | dūcù | to keep pushing (someone to get something done) |
| 分配 | fēnpèi | to assign / allocate (tasks, resources) |
| 对接 | duìjiē | to liaise with (the person handling the other side) |
| 按时 | ànshí | on time (by the scheduled date) |
| 落后 | luòhòu | to fall behind (schedule, others) |
| 分工 | fēngōng | to divide up the work |

## Which word?

- **应对 vs 解决 vs 应付**: 应对 is how you respond to a situation (怎么应对). 解决 means the problem is actually fixed (解决了). 应付 is getting by with the minimum, often a criticism (应付一下).
- **推迟 vs 拖延 vs 取消**: 推迟 moves a plan later, neutrally. 拖延 is procrastinating, which is a criticism. 取消 means it's off entirely.
- **进展 vs 进步 vs 落后**: 进展 = developments on a matter (有进展吗?). 进步 = a person getting better. 落后 = behind schedule or behind others.
- **确认 vs 确定**: 确认 checks a fact with someone (确认时间). 确定 is to decide or be sure (还没确定).
- **分配 vs 分工**: 分配 is a boss handing out tasks. 分工 is a team splitting the work among themselves.
- **督促 vs 催**: 督促 is ongoing pressure from someone responsible for you. 催 is a one-off nudge: 帮我催一下.
- **搞定 vs 完成**: 搞定 is casual and implies you overcame some trouble; 完成 is neutral 'complete'.

## Examples

- 遇到这种情况该怎么应对？ yùdào zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng gāi zěnme yìngduì: How should we respond when this kind of thing happens?
- 我帮你安排一下时间。 wǒ bāng nǐ ānpái yíxià shíjiān: Let me set up a time for you
- 会议推迟到下周了。 huìyì tuīchí dào xiàzhōu le: The meeting's been pushed to next week
- 客户的问题要优先处理。 kèhù de wèntí yào yōuxiān chǔlǐ: Customer issues get handled first
- 那个项目有什么进展吗？ nàge xiàngmù yǒu shénme jìnzhǎn ma: Any progress on that project?
- 我再跟你确认一下时间。 wǒ zài gēn nǐ quèrèn yíxià shíjiān: Let me double-check the time with you
- 现在出发已经来不及了。 xiànzài chūfā yǐjīng láibují le: It's too late to leave now
- 他总是拖延，最后一天才开始写。 tā zǒngshì tuōyán, zuìhòu yì tiān cái kāishǐ xiě: He always procrastinates and only starts writing on the last day
- 放心，明天之前肯定搞定。 fàngxīn, míngtiān zhīqián kěndìng gǎodìng: Don't worry, it'll definitely be done before tomorrow
- 你得督促他按时交。 nǐ děi dūcù tā ànshí jiāo: You'll have to keep on him to hand it in on time

cards.English: to respond to / cope with (a situation, a challenge)
cards.Example: 遇到这种情况该怎么应对？ yùdào zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng gāi zěnme yìngduì: How should we respond when this kind of thing happens?
cards.Notes: 应对 = respond to a situation or challenge; 处理 = handle a task; 应付 = just get by, often half-heartedly

cards.English: to solve / resolve (a problem, for good)
cards.Example: 问题已经解决了，不用担心。 wèntí yǐjīng jiějué le, búyòng dānxīn: The problem's been solved, no need to worry
cards.Notes: 解决问题 is the standard collocation; 处理问题 just means you're working on it

cards.English: to arrange / schedule (time, people, plans)
cards.Example: 我帮你安排一下时间。 wǒ bāng nǐ ānpái yíxià shíjiān: Let me set up a time for you
cards.Notes: Also a noun: 你明天有什么安排？ = what are your plans tomorrow?

cards.English: to coordinate (between people or departments)
cards.Example: 这件事得跟几个部门协调一下。 zhè jiàn shì děi gēn jǐ gè bùmén xiétiáo yíxià: This needs to be coordinated with several departments
cards.Notes: Also an adjective: 动作很协调 = well-coordinated movements

cards.English: to postpone / push back (to a later time)
cards.Example: 会议推迟到下周了。 huìyì tuīchí dào xiàzhōu le: The meeting's been pushed to next week
cards.Notes: 推迟 = move later; 延期 = extend or delay a deadline (more formal); 拖延 = procrastinate

cards.English: to cancel
cards.Example: 航班取消了，只能改明天的。 hángbān qǔxiāo le, zhǐ néng gǎi míngtiān de: The flight was cancelled, so I had to switch to tomorrow's
cards.Notes: 取消订单 = cancel an order

cards.English: to give priority to / do first
cards.Example: 客户的问题要优先处理。 kèhù de wèntí yào yōuxiān chǔlǐ: Customer issues get handled first
cards.Notes: 优先级 = priority level; 首先 = first of all (in a sequence of points)

cards.English: to hold others back / be a drag on the team
cards.Example: 我可不想给大家拖后腿。 wǒ kě bù xiǎng gěi dàjiā tuō hòutuǐ: I really don't want to hold everyone back
cards.Notes: Pattern: 给……拖后腿 or 拖……的后腿

cards.English: progress / developments (on a matter)
cards.Example: 那个项目有什么进展吗？ nàge xiàngmù yǒu shénme jìnzhǎn ma: Any progress on that project?
cards.Notes: 进展 = how a matter is moving; 进步 = a person improving

cards.English: to carry out / make sure it actually happens (a plan, a policy)
cards.Example: 计划定了，关键是怎么落实。 jìhuà dìng le, guānjiàn shì zěnme luòshí: The plan is set, the key is how to follow through
cards.Notes: Office and government register; 执行 = execute (more neutral)

cards.English: to confirm
cards.Example: 我再跟你确认一下时间。 wǒ zài gēn nǐ quèrèn yíxià shíjiān: Let me double-check the time with you
cards.Notes: 确认 = confirm a fact; 确定 = decide for sure / be certain

cards.English: to remind (someone)
cards.Example: 到时候提醒我一下，我怕忘了。 dào shíhou tíxǐng wǒ yíxià, wǒ pà wàng le: Remind me when it's time, I'm afraid I'll forget
cards.Notes: 提醒 = remind someone else; 想起来 = remember on your own

cards.English: plan (formal, detailed)
cards.Example: 计划赶不上变化。 jìhuà gǎn bu shàng biànhuà: Plans can never keep up with changes
cards.Notes: 计划 is a concrete plan; 打算 is a looser intention, more spoken

cards.English: time limit / deadline (formal)
cards.Example: 必须在规定期限内完成。 bìxū zài guīdìng qīxiàn nèi wánchéng: It has to be finished within the set time limit
cards.Notes: Written and official; in conversation people say 截止日期 or just deadline

cards.English: step (in a process)
cards.Example: 操作步骤都写在说明书上了。 cāozuò bùzhòu dōu xiě zài shuōmíngshū shang le: The steps are all written in the manual
cards.Notes: Written-leaning; in speech people often just say 一步

cards.English: to check / inspect (for mistakes or problems)
cards.Example: 交之前再检查一遍。 jiāo zhīqián zài jiǎnchá yí biàn: Check it once more before you hand it in
cards.Notes: Also a medical checkup: 去医院检查

cards.English: to adjust
cards.Example: 时间可能要调整一下。 shíjiān kěnéng yào tiáozhěng yíxià: We may need to adjust the timing
cards.Notes: 调 is tiáo here, not diào

cards.English: to not have enough time (to make it)
cards.Example: 现在出发已经来不及了。 xiànzài chūfā yǐjīng láibují le: It's too late to leave now
cards.Notes: Opposite: 来得及 = there's still time

cards.English: to procrastinate / drag things out
cards.Example: 他总是拖延，最后一天才开始写。 tā zǒngshì tuōyán, zuìhòu yì tiān cái kāishǐ xiě: He always procrastinates and only starts writing on the last day
cards.Notes: 拖延症 = chronic procrastination; spoken: 别拖了

cards.English: to get it done / sort it out (colloquial)
cards.Example: 放心，明天之前肯定搞定。 fàngxīn, míngtiān zhīqián kěndìng gǎodìng: Don't worry, it'll definitely be done before tomorrow
cards.Notes: Casual; also works for people: 老板搞定了 = the boss is on board

cards.English: to rush to finish (work against a deadline)
cards.Example: 这几天都在赶工，周末也没休息。 zhè jǐ tiān dōu zài gǎngōng, zhōumò yě méi xiūxi: We've been rushing to finish all week, no weekend either
cards.Notes: 赶 = rush: 赶进度 = catch up on schedule, 赶时间 = be in a hurry

cards.English: to keep pushing (someone to get something done)
cards.Example: 你得督促他按时交。 nǐ děi dūcù tā ànshí jiāo: You'll have to keep on him to hand it in on time
cards.Notes: 督促 = keep supervising and pushing; 催 = hurry someone up (spoken, one-off): 催一下

cards.English: to assign / allocate (tasks, resources)
cards.Example: 任务都已经分配好了。 rènwu dōu yǐjīng fēnpèi hǎo le: The tasks have all been assigned
cards.Notes: 分配 = handed out from above; 分工 = people split the work among themselves

cards.English: to liaise with (the person handling the other side)
cards.Example: 这件事你跟财务那边对接一下。 zhè jiàn shì nǐ gēn cáiwù nàbiān duìjiē yíxià: Liaise with finance on this
cards.Notes: Office jargon; 对接人 = contact person

cards.English: on time (by the scheduled date)
cards.Example: 这些活儿能按时做完吗？ zhèxiē huór néng ànshí zuòwán ma: Can this work be finished on time?
cards.Notes: 按时 = by the scheduled time; 准时 = punctual, at the exact moment

cards.English: to fall behind (schedule, others)
cards.Example: 我们比原计划落后了一个星期。 wǒmen bǐ yuán jìhuà luòhòu le yí gè xīngqī: We're a week behind the original plan
cards.Notes: Also an adjective for places: 落后地区 = underdeveloped region

cards.English: to divide up the work
cards.Example: 我们先分一下工吧。 wǒmen xiān fēn yíxià gōng ba: Let's split up the work first
cards.Notes: Separable: 分一下工; also a noun: 分工明确 = clear division of labor

cards.English: Let's take it one step at a time.
cards.Notes: Also said to calm someone who's overwhelmed

cards.English: I'll get back to you as soon as possible.
cards.Notes: 尽快 = as soon as possible; 回复 = reply (messages, emails)

cards.English: Something came up. Can we do it another day?
cards.Hanzi: 我临时有事，能不能改天？
cards.Pinyin: wǒ línshí yǒu shì, néng bu néng gǎitiān
cards.Notes: 临时 = last-minute; 改天 = another day
